title: 2021 AMC 12B Problem 3
statement:
Suppose \[2+\cfrac{1}{1+\cfrac{1}{2+\cfrac{2}{3+x}}}=\dfrac{144}{53}.\]

What is the value of \(x?\)

solutions.text:
Working from the outside in, \(\dfrac{144}{53}-2=\dfrac{38}{53},\) so the inner fraction equals \(\dfrac{38}{53}.\)

Its reciprocal gives \(1+\cfrac{1}{2+\frac{2}{3+x}}=\dfrac{53}{38},\) so \(\cfrac{1}{2+\frac{2}{3+x}}=\dfrac{15}{38}.\)

Then \(2+\dfrac{2}{3+x}=\dfrac{38}{15},\) so \(\dfrac{2}{3+x}=\dfrac{8}{15},\) giving \(3+x=\dfrac{15}{4}.\)

Therefore \(x=\dfrac{15}{4}-3=\dfrac{3}{4}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Peel off one layer at a time, starting by subtracting \(2\) from \(\dfrac{144}{53}\)
After \(\dfrac{144}{53}-2=\dfrac{38}{53},\) take reciprocals and continue inward
